subject: Re: POC kickoff — Redwood trial for Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff — Redwood trial for Acme Analytics

Hi Emily / Samir —

Great to meet earlier — appreciate you walking through the Acme use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment:

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for search reranking and short-form generation in a 2-week POC; target latency < 150ms tail for 512-token requests.
- Success criteria: 10%+ improvement in relevance metrics on the internal dev prompt set + <1.5x cost increase vs current baseline.
- POC scope: 2 Concurrent workers, Redwood-hosted trial environment, sample dataset (anonymized), onboarding session with our CSM.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You share the anonymized sample dataset + SSO decision (Okta vs SAML) — Emily
2) We schedule a 60-min kickoff to provision the trial + onboarding (we can do next Wed 1/28 or Thu 1/29) — Aditya
3) Procurement to confirm PO template / initial billing contact — Samir

I attached a short onboarding checklist to make the kickoff smooth. If the timeline needs to shift, let me know — we can be flexible.

Thanks again — excited to get you set up.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: acme_onboarding_checklist.pdf (PDF, 34KB)]
